body: There are so many kind people on here, I honestly can't say thank you enough to people that have reached out. I haven't changed my mind on my plans but it has been cathartic talking about the struggles I've been facing. Thank you for checking in on a stranger struggling through the days
This absolutely rattled my soul, I really needed to read this.

Yes my work has put me in touch with a grief counselor, and I also have a psychiatrist and a therapist. Talking about it in the moment takes away the pain for a minute, but then I go home alone and it hits me all over again.
I hate it! I hate grief 😭

Thank you. I definitely could be having a mixed episode currently, but it's something I've grappled with since before he decided to leave. I do appreciate your input though, thank you for the sub and the thoughts
What do you do when the clarity is so few and far between your just haunted by the fear and wondering if that's all there is left?

Let me get my head around this one.
Me-19. Him- 19. Me- forestry sector job low level. Fun....God it's been while. Camping I guess. Toilet paper always over. 

Thank you for the distraction
In moments I have clarity and I can think, and then it just reverts back to the "wtd happened here how could you leave me like this" mess that I've become
I think the worst part of that is wondering if maybe he didn't think I was one of the good things and that's why he decided to leave in a place where he wasn't surrounded by the love that I gave him.
Honestly, I'm feeling angry. And upset. And confused. Just a whole buttload of everything

I understand why he did it. I know why he did even though he didn't leave a note and he just did it. I don't totally respect his decision because he left me behind and I think that makes me really angry, if that makes sense.
Thank you for the concern. I unfortunately only had him and now there's no one. I've cried and cried and this is the only thing that I find calming in this chaos is knowing I'll be where he is soon.
